items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: We got Dink. Wills and Spice had to go Dink. I don't know. We got a hold of him.

ctx.x: That was funny. That was funny.
How come they got Dink on that date to play clarinet? Do you remember?
Yeah. Well, I don't know what happened to Wade, you see.
